newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark says unaware of any BT plans.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark says unaware of any BT plans.

text.p: Danish telecoms group Tele Danmark on Friday said it had no knowledge of any plans by British Telecommunications Plc to take a stake in the 51 percent state-owned Danish firm.
"We know nothing about the British Telecom talk, nor have we had any contact with them," Tele Danmark deputy director Kirsten Fjord told Reuters.
"We must first see what the Danish state plans to do with its shareholding in Tele Danmark," she added.

Rumours of BT plans to take a stake in the Danish telecoms operator caused the share to rise 14 crowns to 335.00 crowns on Wednesday. The share traded five crowns up on that figure at 340 at 1200 GMT on Friday.
Tele Danmark Chairman Knud Heinesen said in April that the state might reduce its holding in the coming months and its board was prepared to buy up to 10 percent of shares on offer.
